name: Type 96 Wheeled Armored Personnel Carrier
armament: 40 mm Type 96 AGL or 12.7 mm M2 in a roof cupola
protection: Welded steel, deployed to Iraq (Samawah) 2004-06 with add-on armour. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds (5.45/5.56/5.8/7.62x39/7.62x51 ball); 7.62x54R and larger penetrate side/rear and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Boxy 8x8 with axles grouped 2+2, flat sides and a slab front
Commander's cupola with AGL or 12.7 mm, roof hatches over troop compartment
Rear ramp door; being replaced by the Patria AMV XP
